key.name: settings-version
key.description: Used by the settings application to migrate stored values between releases. 0 means the settings were never migrated.

key.name: legacy-settings-migrated
key.summary: Settings of Better GNOME Desktop were taken over
key.description: Set once the settings stored by Better GNOME Desktop (0.3.0 and older) were copied here. Values already set here are never overwritten; the former settings are kept.

key.name: show-desktop-at-login
key.summary: Show the desktop after logging in
key.description: When true, a new session starts on the desktop instead of the activities overview. Only the start of the session is affected: opening the overview later, unlocking the screen or turning features on and off never closes it. Applied by the dock extension.

key.name: position
key.description: "left", "bottom" or "right".

key.name: length
key.description: "fit": only as long as the icons need. "full": the whole screen edge.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Scaled by the monitor scale and the text scaling factor of the shell theme like other GNOME Shell icons.

key.name: hide-mode
key.description: "never": always visible and windows are kept out of its area. "intellihide": hidden while a window on the same monitor overlaps it. "autohide": hidden until the pointer reaches the screen edge.

key.name: monitor-mode
key.summary: On which monitors the dock is shown
key.description: "primary", "selected" (see selected-monitor) or "all".

key.name: selected-monitor
key.description: Connector name such as "DP-1". Used when monitor-mode is "selected"; falls back to the primary monitor while that monitor is not connected.

key.name: apps-button-position
key.description: "start": first item of the dock (left in a horizontal dock, top in a vertical one). "end": last item (right or bottom).

key.name: apps-button-icon
key.description: "default": the GNOME applications icon. "distribution": the logo of the installed distribution, from the icons installed on the system; the default icon when there is none. "custom": the image in apps-button-custom-icon.

key.name: apps-button-custom-icon
key.summary: Custom icon of the applications button
key.description: Path of a copy of the chosen image, kept in the user data folder of Deskence so it keeps working when the original file is moved or deleted. The default icon is used when the file cannot be loaded.

key.name: magnify
key.description: Icons near the pointer grow smoothly while it moves over the dock. Not shown while animations are turned off in GNOME.

key.name: magnify-strength
key.description: Size of the icon under the pointer relative to its normal size.

key.name: background-custom-color
key.description: When false, the dock background has the color of the current GNOME style.

key.name: background-color
key.description: Color as "#rrggbb", used when background-custom-color is true. It has no transparency of its own: that is background-transparency.

key.name: background-custom-transparency
key.description: When false, the dock background is as transparent as the current GNOME style makes it.

key.name: background-transparency
key.description: 0: opaque. 100: fully transparent. Only the background; icons, indicators, labels and menus keep their own visibility. Used when background-custom-transparency is true.

key.name: app-grid-custom-transparency
key.summary: Custom background transparency of the applications view
key.description: When false, the full-screen applications view opened from the dock has the standard GNOME background.

key.name: app-grid-custom-color
key.summary: Custom background color of the applications view
key.description: When false, the full-screen applications view opened from the dock has the color of the standard GNOME background. Independent of the dock background.

key.name: app-grid-color
key.summary: Background color of the applications view
key.description: Color as "#rrggbb", used when app-grid-custom-color is true. It has no transparency of its own: that is app-grid-transparency (or opaque when app-grid-custom-transparency is false).

key.name: app-grid-transparency
key.summary: Background transparency of the applications view
key.description: 0: opaque background (standard or custom color). 100: fully transparent, only the wallpaper is visible behind the applications. Only the background changes; icons, names and the search entry stay fully visible. Used when app-grid-custom-transparency is true.

key.name: app-grid-folder-custom-color
key.summary: Custom background color of application folders
key.description: When false, the folder tiles in the applications view (such as "Utilities") have the color of the current GNOME style. Only the tile background changes; the application thumbnails and the folder name stay as they are, and the panel of an open folder is not affected.

key.name: app-grid-folder-color
key.description: Color as "#rrggbb", used when app-grid-folder-custom-color is true. It has no transparency of its own: that is app-grid-folder-transparency (or the alpha of the GNOME style when app-grid-folder-custom-transparency is false).

key.name: app-grid-folder-custom-transparency
key.summary: Custom background transparency of application folders
key.description: When false, the folder tiles in the applications view are as opaque as the current GNOME style makes them.

key.name: app-grid-folder-transparency
key.description: 0: opaque tile background. 100: fully transparent; the folder is recognized by its application thumbnails and name. Hover, selection and keyboard focus stay visible. Used when app-grid-folder-custom-transparency is true.

key.name: app-grid-hover-custom-color
key.summary: Custom hover highlight color in the applications view
key.description: When false, the highlight shown under the pointer on applications, application folders and applications inside an open folder has the color of the current GNOME style. The dock, the desktop and folder stacks are not affected.

key.name: app-grid-hover-color
key.summary: Hover highlight color in the applications view
key.description: Color as "#rrggbb", used when app-grid-hover-custom-color is true. It has no transparency of its own: that is app-grid-hover-transparency (or the alpha of the GNOME style when app-grid-hover-custom-transparency is false).

key.name: app-grid-hover-custom-transparency
key.summary: Custom hover highlight transparency in the applications view
key.description: When false, the hover highlight is as opaque as the current GNOME style makes it.

key.name: app-grid-hover-transparency
key.summary: Hover highlight transparency in the applications view
key.description: 0: opaque highlight. 100: fully transparent; a folder then looks the same under the pointer as at rest. Only the highlight changes; icons and names stay fully visible, and keyboard focus stays marked. Used when app-grid-hover-custom-transparency is true.

key.name: click-action
key.description: "focus-or-cycle": focus the most recently used window; when the application is already focused, switch to its next window. "minimize-or-cycle": like focus-or-cycle, but an application with a single focused window is minimized.

key.name: isolate-workspaces
key.summary: Only show applications of the current workspace
key.description: When true, running (non-pinned) applications are listed only when they have a window on the active workspace, and clicking cycles only through those windows.

key.name: show-app-counts
key.description: When true, an application that reports a counter (for example unread messages, through the LauncherEntry D-Bus API) shows it on its dock icon. Applications that report nothing show nothing.

key.name: show-app-progress
key.description: When true, an application that reports the progress of an operation (for example a download, through the LauncherEntry D-Bus API) shows it as a bar on its dock icon.

key.name: window-previews
key.description: When the pointer rests on a running application, show its windows (the ones the dock counts, see isolate-workspaces) with their titles; clicking one activates that window.

key.name: window-peek
key.summary: Peek at a window from its preview
key.description: While the pointer rests on a window preview, that window is shown over the dimmed others for a moment. Nothing is focused, raised, restored or moved; leaving the preview or pressing Escape ends it.

key.name: folder-stacks
key.description: Folders shown in the dock, in order. Each entry is "xdg:NAME" for a standard folder (NAME as in GLib.UserDirectory without the DIRECTORY_ prefix, for example "xdg:DOWNLOAD"), "home:RELATIVE/PATH" for a folder in the home folder, or a "file://" URI for any other folder. Removing an entry never touches the folder.

key.name: show-folder-stacks
key.description: When false, the folders in folder-stacks are kept but not shown.

key.name: folder-stack-view
key.description: "grid": large icons. "list": smaller icons with size and date. Changed from the folder panel.

key.name: folder-stack-sorting
key.description: Maps an entry of folder-stacks to "name", "modified" (newest first) or "type". A folder without an entry is sorted by name, except Downloads (xdg:DOWNLOAD), which shows the newest files first. Changed from the folder panel.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: "small" (48 px), "medium" (64 px), "large" (96 px) or "huge" (128 px).

key.name: start-corner
key.summary: Corner where new icons are placed

key.name: icon-placement
key.description: "free": icons stay exactly where they are dropped. "grid": dropped icons snap to the grid. Changing this does not move existing icons; "Align to Grid" in the desktop menu does.

key.name: click-mode
key.summary: Open items with a single or double click

key.name: sort-order
key.description: Changed from the desktop menu "Sort By".

key.name: show-passive
key.description: StatusNotifierItem defines a "Passive" status for icons an application considers unimportant. They are hidden unless this is true.

key.name: original-button-layout
key.summary: Button layout before the first change
key.description: Value of org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences button-layout saved before Deskence changed it for the first time. Empty when nothing was changed.

key.name: last-written-button-layout
key.summary: Button layout last written by Deskence
key.description: Used to tell whether the user changed the layout elsewhere afterwards; the original value is only offered for restoring while the current value still equals this one.

key.name: sort-mode
key.description: "custom": the arrangement made by the user (GNOME's own app-picker-layout and folder lists). "alphabetical": applications and folders by display name in the user's language, and the applications inside each folder too; rearranging by dragging is turned off. Kept up to date by the app-grid extension.

key.name: manual-layout
key.description: JSON written when sort-mode changes to "alphabetical": the previous org.gnome.shell app-picker-layout (GVariant text) and the application list of each folder. It is restored when sort-mode goes back to "custom". Internal; not part of presets.

key.name: shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the clipboard history

key.name: max-entries
key.description: Pinned items do not count. The oldest items are forgotten first.

key.name: remember
key.summary: What is kept after logging out
key.description: "nothing": the history is only kept in memory and is gone after logging out. "pinned": pinned items are saved in the user data folder. "all": the whole history is saved there.

key.name: paused
key.description: Temporary state changed from the history panel; not part of presets.

key.name: include-primary
key.description: Text selected with the mouse (the primary selection, pasted with the middle button) is added to the history too.

key.name: paste-plain-text
key.description: The history keeps text without formatting; only the newest item, while the application it was copied from still provides it, can be pasted with its formatting. When true, that item is pasted as plain text too. Shift+Enter in the history pastes plain text either way.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste the chosen item at once
key.description: When true, choosing an item closes the panel and pastes it into the window that was focused, with Ctrl+V. When false, the item is only put on the clipboard.

key.name: keep-screen-on
key.description: When false, keeping the computer awake only prevents automatic suspend: the screen still turns off and locks as usual. When true, the screen also stays on and does not lock automatically.

key.name: last-choice
key.summary: Duration used by the quick settings button
key.description: The duration chosen last; clicking the button uses it again.

key.name: until-time
key.summary: End time in minutes after midnight
key.description: Used by "until a time": the next occurrence of this local time.
